The design brief / Self-initiated study

The brief.

A service information-system study showing request, review and processing information in clear stages.

The challenge

Service request and review stages can become unclear when responsibilities and processing information overlap.

Design direction.

Separate request, review and processing into identifiable stages using a consistent information system.
